As your kerbals get out and explore they will experience new and exciting situations. These translate to 
increases in each kerbal's experience level and can increase their skill levels.

Each kerbal gains experience from flybys, orbiting, flight, landing and planting flags on planets. The 
further from home they are, the more experience they will gain for each, but do note they only get XP 
for the first time they complete one of these around each planet.
Note: Near death experience is unrelated to this topic, but a likely occurence in a kerbal's lifetime.
